notes.title: Cozy Farm Update
notes.content: [p][b]Cozy Farm Update 🌾🎃[/b][/p][p]The pumpkins are on their way, the squash and the fall garden are just around the corner! 🍂 We’re excited to bring some cozy autumn vibes to the farm.[/p][p]Sorry for the delay in updates — this cat had to move dens for a bit 🐾🏡 … but we’re back, and there’s so much more coming soon.[/p][p]Stay tuned, farmers — the best season is just getting started! 🌻✨[/p]
